intro_text: Hi everyone! I'm Camille, a Tooele based photographer! I'm a mom, BYU graduate, powerlifter, and lover of photography. Available for family, couples, maternity, newborn, seniors sessions, etc! I offer sessions at about half the going rate because I need to grow my portfolio.

session.title: Photography Session
session.description: Families, couples, maternity, newborns, seniors, and portraits.

faq.question: WHAT SHOULD I WEAR?
faq.answer: Think coordinate, don't match! Choose a neutral color scheme and include different layers. Avoid loud patterns; one soft pattern is great.

faq.question: HOW MANY PHOTOS WILL I RECEIVE?
HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE TO GET OUR PHOTOS?
faq.answer: I should have them back to you within 2 weeks!

faq.question: CAN YOU RECOMMEND ANY GOOD LOCATIONS?
faq.answer: Absolutely. I have plenty of suggestions for the Tooele County area and can help you choose a location that fits the look you want.
